Other names often found for such a device include belt analyzer, crossbelt analyzer and elemental analyzer. This product first found popularity in the cement industry during the 1990s, and today most new cement plants include at least one analyzer, if not two.== Cement industry ==A couple of applications predominate for the bulk material analyzer in cement production.=== Stockpile management ===One is known as "stockpile management," whereby an analyzer located upstream of the pile is able to track the cumulative chemistry of the pile.  This allows the operator to direct haul trucks to different sections of the quarry in a way that will result in the final elemental composition of the pile close to target.=== Raw mix proportioning ===A second application in cement for the bulk material analyzer is raw mix proportioning.  An analyzer placed just upstream of the raw mill can monitor the chemistry of the raw mix and automatically trigger an adjustment in the proportions of the reclaimed stockpile and the correctives.  By doing so, the plant is able to reduce the variability in the raw mix, and later on the kiln feed.  Consistent kiln feed chemistry in turn leads to lower fuel consumption per ton of clinker produced.

AFN Bremerhaven began broadcasting in 1945, originally as AFN Bremen.The station began operating just after World War II ended in Europe.  It was originally established in the north German city of Bremen in allied-occupied Germany as a small AM radio station with an AM repeater transmitter also broadcasting the station's signal in Bremerhaven, Germany, a port city on the Weser River near the entrance to the North Sea located just north of Bremen.== Military mission ==The radio station's mission was to provide information and entertainment to members of the American forces who were based in that part of northern Germany.  After World War II, the small north German US occupied area was originally known as the "Bremen Enclave", and it was an "American island" located in the portion of the newly formed West Germany that was originally occupied and controlled by British forces, (The British Occupation Zone of West Germany).== History ==Just after World War II, the port city of Bremerhaven was one of the major ports from where American forces embarked for return to the United States after fighting in the Second World War; later, the port brought US military personnel, their families, military equipment, as well as food and goods for the rebuilding of Europe to Germany via ships from the US.  Many of these shipments were, in part, in support of the Marshall Plan designed to assist and re-build war-torn Europe. Later, in the 1960s, and thereafter, most personnel movement was done via air travel.
original_question: In which country was AFN Bremerhaven located?
content:
L'AFN Bremerhaven était à l'origine une station de "Radio et Télévision des Forces Armées" (AFRTS). (L'AFRTS, dans le monde entier, est désormais également connue sous le nom de "American Forces Network" ou "AFN"). La station affiliée de Bremerhaven était située dans le nord de l'Allemagne. À l'époque, elle faisait partie du "American Forces Network - Europe". L'AFN Bremerhaven a commencé à émettre en 1945, initialement sous le nom d'AFN Bremen. La station a commencé à fonctionner juste après la fin de la Seconde Guerre mondiale en Europe. == Mission militaire ==
La mission de la station de radio était de fournir des informations et des divertissements aux membres des forces américaines qui étaient basées dans cette partie du nord de l'Allemagne. Après la Seconde Guerre mondiale, la petite zone occupée par les États-Unis dans le nord de l'Allemagne était initialement connue sous le nom d'"enclave de Brême", et c'était une "île américaine" située dans la partie de l'Allemagne de l'Ouest nouvellement formée qui était initialement occupée et contrôlée par les forces britanniques (la zone d'occupation britannique de l'Allemagne de l'Ouest).

Juste après la Seconde Guerre mondiale, la ville portuaire de Bremerhaven était l'un des principaux ports d'où les forces américaines embarquaient pour retourner aux États-Unis après avoir combattu pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale ; plus tard, le port a amené en Allemagne, par bateau depuis les États-Unis, du personnel militaire américain, leurs familles, du matériel militaire, ainsi que de la nourriture et des biens pour la reconstruction de l'Europe. Nombre de ces expéditions étaient, en partie, destinées à soutenir le plan Marshall conçu pour aider et reconstruire l'Europe déchirée par la guerre. original_content: Flood Modeller is a computer program developed by Jacobs that assesses flood risk by simulating the flow of water through river channels, urban drainage networks and across floodplains using a range of one- and two-dimensional hydraulic solvers. Flood Modeller was previously known as "ISIS" (after the local name for the Upper Thames).== Solvers ===== 1D solvers ===Flood Modeller includes steady-state and unsteady 1D river solvers for modelling open-channels.It also provides a 1D urban solver for modelling urban drainage systems.=== 2D solvers ===Flood Modeller includes three different 2D solvers:The ADI solver is based on the DIVAST numerical engine first developed in the 1980s, and is designed to simulate fluvial, overland, estuarine and coastal situations where flow does not rapidly change.The TVD solver is designed to represent rapid changes in the water surface profile, but results in longer run-times.The FAST solver uses simplified hydraulics to perform rapid assessments of flooding.

original_content: The Arroyo Penasco Group is a group of geological formations exposed in the Nacimiento, Jemez, Sandia, and Sangre de Cristo Mountains of northern New Mexico. It preserves fossils characteristic of the late Mississippian.== Description ==The Arroyo Penasco Group consists of marine sedimentary formations, primarily massive limestone but with some sandstone. It is divided into the lower Espiritu Santo Formation and the upper Tererro Formation.The lowermost part of the Espiritu Santo Formation is designated the Del Padre Member and is a transgressive siltstone, sandstone, and shale unit, which interfingers with the carbonate rocks of the upper Espiritu Santo Formation, recording the advance of the sea into the area. A similar sequence is seen in the Tererro Formation, whose base is a collapse breccia.The group rests everywhere on Precambrian basement that shows remarkably little relief, suggesting that the group was deposited on a peneplain. Its outcrops are spotty and its upper contact shows indications of well-developed karst topography, often filled in by the iron-rich sediments of the Log Springs Formation, indicating that it was heavily eroded before deposition of the Sandia Formation.The Espiritu Santo Formation has undergone dolomitization, dedolomitization, and calcitization of gypsum and the Macho Member (the lowest part of the Tererro Formation) has experienced dissolution and brecciation. Together with the presence of paleosilcretes in the Manuelitas Member, the middle part of the Tererro Formation, this suggests a history of at least four episodes of sea level fluctuation during the Mississippian in northern New Mexico.

Il conserve des fossiles caractéristiques du Mississippien tardif.== Description ==Le Groupe d'Arroyo Penasco est constitué de formations sédimentaires marines, principalement du calcaire massif mais aussi du grès. Il est divisé en deux formations : la Formation d'Espiritu Santo inférieure et la Formation de Tererro supérieure.La partie la plus basse de la Formation d'Espiritu Santo est appelée Membre de Del Padre et est une unité transgressive de siltstone, grès et schiste, qui s'intercale avec les roches carbonatées de la partie supérieure de la Formation d'Espiritu Santo, enregistrant l'avancée de la mer dans la région. Une séquence similaire est observée dans la Formation de Tererro, dont la base est une brèche d'effondrement.Le groupe repose partout sur un socle précambrien qui présente un relief remarquablement faible, ce qui suggère que le groupe a été déposé sur une pénéplaine. Ses affleurements sont clairsemés et son contact supérieur montre des indications d'une topographie karstique bien développée, souvent remplie par les sédiments riches en fer de la Formation de Log Springs, indiquant qu'il a été fortement érodé avant le dépôt de la Formation de Sandia.La Formation d'Espiritu Santo a subi une dolomitisation, une dédolomitisation et une calcitisation du gypse, tandis que le Membre de Macho (la partie la plus basse de la Formation de Tererro) a connu une dissolution et une bréchification. Associé à la présence de paléosilcrètes dans le Membre de Manuelitas, la partie médiane de la Formation de Tererro, cela suggère une histoire d'au moins quatre épisodes de fluctuation du niveau de la mer pendant le Mississippien dans le nord du Nouveau-Mexique.

original_content: The NIH MERIT award (Method To Extend Research in Time) Award (R37) was created by the National Institutes of Health in 1986. It is a prestigious award designed to provide stable, long-term funding support to outstanding, experienced investigators whose productivity is distinctly superior and who are deemed highly likely to continue to perform their research activities in an outstanding manner. The MERIT award provided funding for 5 years and could be renewed for up to 10 years. Unlike most NIH grant awards, the MERIT award can not be applied for by the investigator. Researchers submitting an R01 that receives a fundable score are considered for the award. In 2018, the NIH began awarding MERIT awards to "Early Stage Investigators", who are in the first 10 years of their career.
original_question: In what year was the NIH MERIT Award first created?
content:
Réponse en français :
Le prix MERIT (Method To Extend Research in Time) des NIH (R37) a été créé par les National Institutes of Health en 1986. Il s'agit d'un prix prestigieux conçu pour fournir un financement stable et à long terme à des chercheurs exceptionnels et expérimentés dont la productivité est nettement supérieure et qui sont jugés très susceptibles de continuer à mener leurs activités de recherche de manière remarquable. Le prix MERIT fournissait un financement pendant 5 ans et pouvait être renouvelé jusqu'à 10 ans. Contrairement à la plupart des subventions NIH, le prix MERIT ne peut pas être demandé par le chercheur. Les chercheurs qui soumettent un R01 recevant un score finançable sont pris en compte pour le prix. En 2018, les NIH ont commencé à attribuer des prix MERIT aux "chercheurs en début de carrière", qui sont dans les 10 premières années de leur carrière.
question: En quelle année le prix MERIT des NIH a-t-il été créé pour la première fois ?

original_content: Vedder Crossing is adjacent to the junction of the Chilliwack and Vedder Rivers at its southern boundary, and Promontory Road to the north.== History ==The area was sparsely populated until about 1941 when CFB Chilliwack was established (then called Camp Chilliwack) between Watson Road and Keith Wilson.  The base became a major training facility for the Canadian Army until its closing in 1997.  Part of CFB Chilliwack became a residential subdivision known as Garrison Crossing, and its training facilities became the Canada Education Park, a local campus for the University of the Fraser Valley. The Chilcotin Training Area, better known as the OPSEE Area(Operator Special Engineering Equipment Training Area), is still operational and is part of Western Area Training Centre (WATC). The OPSEE Area is used by the Primary Reserves units of British Columbia for field training and for the use of its firing ranges. The ASU is also used by Cadets for field training. The ASU also houses supply depots for the Canadian Army units of 39 Canadian Brigade Group, and the cadet units of BC. The old quartermaster warehouse is now the Canadian Military Education Centre Museum.
original_question: What was the name of the military base established in the Vedder Crossing area in 1941?
content: Vedder Crossing est situé à la jonction des rivières Chilliwack et Vedder, à sa limite sud, et de Promontory Road, au nord.== Historique ==La région est restée peu peuplée jusqu'en 1941 environ, lorsque la BFC Chilliwack a été établie (alors appelée Camp Chilliwack) entre Watson Road et Keith Wilson. La base est devenue un important centre d'entraînement pour l'armée canadienne jusqu'à sa fermeture en 1997. Une partie de la BFC Chilliwack est devenue un lotissement résidentiel connu sous le nom de Garrison Crossing, et ses installations d'entraînement sont devenues le Parc éducatif du Canada, un campus local de l'Université de la vallée du Fraser. La zone d'entraînement de Chilcotin, mieux connue sous le nom de zone OPSEE (zone d'entraînement à l'équipement d'ingénierie spécial de l'opérateur), est toujours opérationnelle et fait partie du Centre d'entraînement de la zone ouest (CEZO). La zone OPSEE est utilisée par les unités de la Réserve primaire de la Colombie-Britannique pour l'entraînement sur le terrain et l'utilisation de ses champs de tir. L'USA est également utilisée par les cadets pour l'entraînement sur le terrain. L'USA abrite également des dépôts d'approvisionnement pour les unités de l'armée canadienne du 39e Groupe-brigade du Canada et les unités de cadets de la Colombie-Britannique. L'ancien entrepôt du quartier-maître est maintenant le musée du Centre d'éducation militaire canadien.

original_content: The Fifth Labour Government of New Zealand was the government of New Zealand from 10 December 1999 to 19 November 2008. Labour Party leader Helen Clark negotiated a coalition with Jim Anderton, leader of the Alliance Party. While undertaking a number of substantial reforms, it was not particularly radical compared to previous Labour governments.== Overview ==The previous government, the fourth National government, had been in power since 1990. It was widely unpopular by 1999, with much of the public antagonised by a series of free-market economic reforms, and was bedevilled by weakness and instability. In the 1999 general election, the Helen Clark-led Labour Party defeated the National Party easily, becoming the largest single party in the House of Representatives. Labour formed a minority coalition government with the left-leaning Alliance party, supported by the Green Party.During its first term, the government pursued a number of reforms. The controversial Employment Contracts Act was repealed, replaced by an Employment Relations Act more friendly to unions and collective bargaining; a state-owned bank, Kiwibank, was created at the behest of the Alliance; a majority stake in the national airline, Air New Zealand, was purchased; and the public health sector was reorganised with the re-establishment of partly elected district health boards. Closing the Gaps, an affirmative action strategy targeting socio-economic inequalities between Māori and Pasifika ethnic groups and other groups, was a particularly controversial reform among right-wing National and ACT voters.
original_question: In the 1999 New Zealand general election, which party did Helen Clark lead to victory?
content:
Le cinquième gouvernement travailliste de Nouvelle-Zélande a dirigé la Nouvelle-Zélande du 10 décembre 1999 au 19 novembre 2008. La cheffe du Parti travailliste, Helen Clark, a négocié une coalition avec Jim Anderton, chef du Parti de l'Alliance. Bien qu'il ait entrepris un certain nombre de réformes substantielles, ce gouvernement n'était pas particulièrement radical par rapport aux précédents gouvernements travaillistes.

== Vue d'ensemble ==
Le gouvernement précédent, le quatrième gouvernement national, était au pouvoir depuis 1990. Il était largement impopulaire en 1999, une grande partie du public étant irritée par une série de réformes économiques libérales, et était affligé par la faiblesse et l'instabilité. Lors des élections générales de 1999, le Parti travailliste dirigé par Helen Clark a facilement battu le Parti national, devenant le plus grand parti unique à la Chambre des représentants. Le Parti travailliste a formé un gouvernement de coalition minoritaire avec le parti de gauche Alliance, soutenu par le Parti vert.

Au cours de son premier mandat, le gouvernement a entrepris un certain nombre de réformes. La controversée Loi sur les contrats de travail a été abrogée, remplacée par une Loi sur les relations de travail plus favorable aux syndicats et à la négociation collective ; une banque d'État, Kiwibank, a été créée à la demande de l'Alliance ; une participation majoritaire dans la compagnie aérienne nationale, Air New Zealand, a été achetée ; et le secteur de la santé publique a été réorganisé avec le rétablissement de conseils de santé de district partiellement élus. La stratégie de réduction des écarts, une stratégie d'action positive ciblant les inégalités socio-économiques entre les groupes ethniques maoris et pasifiks et d'autres groupes, a été une réforme particulièrement controversée parmi les électeurs de droite du Parti national et de l'ACT.
question: Aux élections générales néo-zélandaises de 1999, quel parti Helen Clark a-t-elle mené à la victoire ?
title: Fifth Labour Government of New Zealand

original_content: The Whitehaven Academy (formerly Whitehaven School) is a comprehensive co-educational secondary school with academy status, located in Whitehaven, in west Cumbria, England. The school was established in 1984.== History ==The Whitehaven School opened in 1984 taking pupils from the Whitehaven Grammar School which had moved to the Overend site in 1968, Overend School itself which had opened on this site in 1960, and Richmond Street Secondary Modern School which had occupied the former Grammar School site in 1969.It had a full inspection in 2004 where it was described as a larger than average improving school. It noted "Its pupils’ socio-economic circumstances are well below average with an above average number known to be entitled to free school meals. Standards on entry to the school are below average; those of the boys are well below."A February 2011 report from the Office for Standards in Education, Children's Services and Skills (Ofsted) said that then Whitehaven School has made inadequate progress in making improvements and demonstrating a better capacity for sustained improvement' in the previous two years, according to a report issued subsequent to an Ofsted team visit in January 2011. Lynette Norris, who took over as headteacher in 2011, was described as bringing 'vision and energy' to the school since she took office.=== Whitehaven Academy ===The school converted to academy status in January 2014, sponsored by the Bright Tribe Trust, and was renamed the Whitehaven Academy. The past records of school were obscured, it gained a new Ofsted Unique Reference Number and establishment number.In January 2015 the trust announced that they had appointed Philip Grant as the new principal, who was moving to the academy from Newton Rigg College, Penrith  where he was the director of studies.
original_question: In which year did the Whitehaven School become the Whitehaven Academy?
content: L'Académie de Whitehaven (anciennement Whitehaven School) est une école secondaire mixte complète avec le statut d'académie, située à Whitehaven, dans l'ouest de la Cumbria, en Angleterre. L'école a été créée en 1984.== Historique ==La Whitehaven School a ouvert ses portes en 1984, accueillant les élèves de la Whitehaven Grammar School qui avait déménagé sur le site d'Overend en 1968, de l'Overend School elle-même qui avait ouvert sur ce site en 1960, et de la Richmond Street Secondary Modern School qui avait occupé le site de l'ancienne Grammar School en 1969.L'école a fait l'objet d'une inspection complète en 2004, où elle a été décrite comme une école en cours d'amélioration, plus grande que la moyenne. L'inspection a noté que "les conditions socio-économiques de ses élèves sont bien inférieures à la moyenne, avec un nombre supérieur à la moyenne d'élèves connus pour avoir droit à des repas scolaires gratuits. Les niveaux à l'entrée de l'école sont inférieurs à la moyenne, ceux des garçons sont très inférieurs."Un rapport de février 2011 de l'Office for Standards in Education, Children's Services and Skills (Ofsted) a déclaré que la Whitehaven School d'alors avait fait des progrès insuffisants en matière d'amélioration et de démonstration d'une meilleure capacité d'amélioration durable au cours des deux années précédentes, selon un rapport publié à la suite d'une visite de l'équipe de l'Ofsted en janvier 2011. Lynette Norris, qui a pris la direction de l'école en 2011, a été décrite comme apportant "une vision et une énergie" à l'école depuis sa prise de fonction.=== Académie de Whitehaven ===L'école a obtenu le statut d'académie en janvier 2014, parrainée par le Bright Tribe Trust, et a été rebaptisée Whitehaven Academy. question: En quelle année la Whitehaven School est-elle devenue la Whitehaven Academy ?

original_content: The term bulk material analyzer is the generic noun for that device which fits around a conveyor belt and conducts real-time elemental analysis of the material on the belt.  Other names often found for such a device include belt analyzer, crossbelt analyzer and elemental analyzer. This product first found popularity in the cement industry during the 1990s, and today most new cement plants include at least one analyzer, if not two.== Cement industry ==A couple of applications predominate for the bulk material analyzer in cement production.=== Stockpile management ===One is known as "stockpile management," whereby an analyzer located upstream of the pile is able to track the cumulative chemistry of the pile.  This allows the operator to direct haul trucks to different sections of the quarry in a way that will result in the final elemental composition of the pile close to target.=== Raw mix proportioning ===A second application in cement for the bulk material analyzer is raw mix proportioning.  An analyzer placed just upstream of the raw mill can monitor the chemistry of the raw mix and automatically trigger an adjustment in the proportions of the reclaimed stockpile and the correctives.  By doing so, the plant is able to reduce the variability in the raw mix, and later on the kiln feed.  Consistent kiln feed chemistry in turn leads to lower fuel consumption per ton of clinker produced.
original_question: What was the specific purpose of a bulk material analyzer located just upstream of the raw mill in cement production?
original_answer: To monitor raw mix chemistry and adjust the proportions of materials used

Un analyseur placé juste en amont du broyeur à cru peut surveiller la composition chimique du mélange brut et déclencher automatiquement un ajustement des proportions du stock récupéré et des correctifs. original_content: The right of access, also referred to as right to access and (data) subject access, is one of the most fundamental rights in data protection laws around the world. For instance, the United States, Singapore, Brazil, and countries in Europe have all developed laws that regulate access to personal data as privacy protection. Le droit d'accès, également appelé droit d'accès et d'accès des personnes concernées (données), est l'un des droits les plus fondamentaux des lois sur la protection des données dans le monde. Par exemple, les États-Unis, Singapour, le Brésil et les pays d'Europe ont tous élaboré des lois qui réglementent l'accès aux données personnelles en tant que protection de la vie privée. L'Union européenne déclare : "Le droit d'accès occupe une place centrale dans l'arsenal des mesures d'autonomisation des personnes concernées du droit européen de la protection des données." Ce droit est souvent mis en œuvre sous la forme d'une demande d'accès de la personne concernée (SAR) ou d'une demande d'accès des personnes concernées (DSAR).

== Nations unies ==
L'objectif 9 de l'ambitieux objectif de développement durable 16 appelle à la fourniture d'une identité légale à tous les êtres humains. "Dans l'économie numérique, cela devient le droit à une identité numérique." Une telle identité pourrait aider à déposer des demandes d'accès des personnes concernées.

== Brésil ==
La loi générale brésilienne sur la protection des données (LGPD) est sa première réglementation complète sur la protection des données. Selon la LGPD, les demandes d'accès des personnes concernées doivent être satisfaites dans un délai de 15 jours.

== Union européenne ==
Le droit d'accès est inscrit comme faisant partie du droit fondamental à la protection des données dans la Charte des droits fondamentaux de l'Union européenne. C'est en fait le seul des droits pratiques relatifs aux données personnelles qui y figure.
Dans le RGPD, ce droit est défini dans diverses sections de l'article 15.

Its outcrops are spotty and its upper contact shows indications of well-developed karst topography, often filled in by the iron-rich sediments of the Log Springs Formation, indicating that it was heavily eroded before deposition of the Sandia Formation.The Espiritu Santo Formation has undergone dolomitization, dedolomitization, and calcitization of gypsum and the Macho Member (the lowest part of the Tererro Formation) has experienced dissolution and brecciation. Together with the presence of paleosilcretes in the Manuelitas Member, the middle part of the Tererro Formation, this suggests a history of at least four episodes of sea level fluctuation during the Mississippian in northern New Mexico.

original_content: The Fifth Labour Government of New Zealand was the government of New Zealand from 10 December 1999 to 19 November 2008. Labour Party leader Helen Clark negotiated a coalition with Jim Anderton, leader of the Alliance Party. While undertaking a number of substantial reforms, it was not particularly radical compared to previous Labour governments.== Overview ==The previous government, the fourth National government, had been in power since 1990. It was widely unpopular by 1999, with much of the public antagonised by a series of free-market economic reforms, and was bedevilled by weakness and instability. In the 1999 general election, the Helen Clark-led Labour Party defeated the National Party easily, becoming the largest single party in the House of Representatives. Labour formed a minority coalition government with the left-leaning Alliance party, supported by the Green Party.During its first term, the government pursued a number of reforms. The controversial Employment Contracts Act was repealed, replaced by an Employment Relations Act more friendly to unions and collective bargaining; a state-owned bank, Kiwibank, was created at the behest of the Alliance; a majority stake in the national airline, Air New Zealand, was purchased; and the public health sector was reorganised with the re-establishment of partly elected district health boards. Closing the Gaps, an affirmative action strategy targeting socio-economic inequalities between Māori and Pasifika ethnic groups and other groups, was a particularly controversial reform among right-wing National and ACT voters.

== 概述 ==

前任政府，即第四届国民党政府，自1990年以来一直执政。到1999年，该政府已广受民众反对，大部分民众对一系列自由市场经济改革感到不满，并受到软弱和不稳定的困扰。在1999年的大选中，由海伦·克拉克领导的工党轻松击败了国民党，成为众议院最大的单一政党。工党与左倾的联盟党组建了少数派联合政府，并得到了绿党的支持。

在第一任期内，政府进行了一系列改革。备受争议的《雇佣合同法》被废除，取而代之的是对工会和集体谈判更为友好的《雇佣关系法》；在联盟党的敦促下，成立了国有银行Kiwibank；政府收购了国家航空公司新西兰航空公司的多数股权；公共卫生部门进行了重组，重新设立了部分民选的地方卫生局。针对毛利人和太平洋岛国人族群与其他族群之间的社会经济不平等的平权行动战略“缩小差距”是一项特别有争议的改革，遭到了右翼国民党和ACT选民的反对。

original_content: The term bulk material analyzer is the generic noun for that device which fits around a conveyor belt and conducts real-time elemental analysis of the material on the belt.  Other names often found for such a device include belt analyzer, crossbelt analyzer and elemental analyzer. This product first found popularity in the cement industry during the 1990s, and today most new cement plants include at least one analyzer, if not two.== Cement industry ==A couple of applications predominate for the bulk material analyzer in cement production.=== Stockpile management ===One is known as "stockpile management," whereby an analyzer located upstream of the pile is able to track the cumulative chemistry of the pile.  This allows the operator to direct haul trucks to different sections of the quarry in a way that will result in the final elemental composition of the pile close to target.=== Raw mix proportioning ===A second application in cement for the bulk material analyzer is raw mix proportioning.  An analyzer placed just upstream of the raw mill can monitor the chemistry of the raw mix and automatically trigger an adjustment in the proportions of the reclaimed stockpile and the correctives.  By doing so, the plant is able to reduce the variability in the raw mix, and later on the kiln feed.  Consistent kiln feed chemistry in turn leads to lower fuel consumption per ton of clinker produced.
original_question: What was the specific purpose of a bulk material analyzer located just upstream of the raw mill in cement production?
original_answer: To monitor raw mix chemistry and adjust the proportions of materials used

original_content: AFN Bremerhaven was originally an "Armed Forces Radio and Television Service" (AFRTS) station. (AFRTS, worldwide, is now also known as "American Forces Network" or "AFN").  The Bremerhaven affiliate station was located in northern Germany. At the time, it was part of the "American Forces Network - Europe."  AFN Bremerhaven began broadcasting in 1945, originally as AFN Bremen.The station began operating just after World War II ended in Europe.  It was originally established in the north German city of Bremen in allied-occupied Germany as a small AM radio station with an AM repeater transmitter also broadcasting the station's signal in Bremerhaven, Germany, a port city on the Weser River near the entrance to the North Sea located just north of Bremen.== Military mission ==The radio station's mission was to provide information and entertainment to members of the American forces who were based in that part of northern Germany.  After World War II, the small north German US occupied area was originally known as the "Bremen Enclave", and it was an "American island" located in the portion of the newly formed West Germany that was originally occupied and controlled by British forces, (The British Occupation Zone of West Germany).== History ==Just after World War II, the port city of Bremerhaven was one of the major ports from where American forces embarked for return to the United States after fighting in the Second World War; later, the port brought US military personnel, their families, military equipment, as well as food and goods for the rebuilding of Europe to Germany via ships from the US.  Many of these shipments were, in part, in support of the Marshall Plan designed to assist and re-build war-torn Europe. Later, in the 1960s, and thereafter, most personnel movement was done via air travel.

משימתה של תחנת הרדיו הייתה לספק מידע ובידור לחברי הכוחות האמריקאיים שהיו מוצבים באותו חלק בצפון גרמניה. לאחר מלחמת העולם השנייה, השטח הקטן בצפון גרמניה שהיה כבוש בידי ארה"ב נודע במקור בשם "מובלעת ברמן", והיה "אי אמריקאי" הממוקם בחלק של גרמניה המערבית שהוקמה לאחרונה, שהיה כבוש ומפוקח במקור על ידי כוחות בריטיים, (אזור הכיבוש הבריטי בגרמניה המערבית).

מיד לאחר מלחמת העולם השנייה, עיר הנמל ברמרהאפן הייתה אחד הנמלים העיקריים שממנו הפליגו הכוחות האמריקאיים חזרה לארצות הברית לאחר הלחימה במלחמת העולם השנייה; מאוחר יותר, הנמל הביא לגרמניה אנשי צבא אמריקאים, משפחותיהם, ציוד צבאי, כמו גם מזון וסחורות לשיקום אירופה באמצעות אוניות מארה"ב. רבות ממשלוחים אלה היו, בחלקם, בתמיכת תוכנית מרשל שנועדה לסייע ולהקים מחדש את אירופה ההרוסה במלחמה. מאוחר יותר, בשנות ה-60 ולאחר מכן, רוב תנועת אנשי הצוות התבצעה באמצעות נסיעות אוויריות.

original_content: August Joseph Donatelli (August 22, 1914 – May 24, 1990) was an American umpire in Major League Baseball who worked in the National League from 1950 to 1973. Highly regarded for his ability, he was also known for his inclination to eject players and managers quickly and dramatically. He was on the cover of the first issue of Sports Illustrated, with catcher Wes Westrum and batter Eddie Mathews, in August 1954.== Life and career ==Known as Gus to those close with him, Donatelli was born in Heilwood, Pennsylvania, and raised in Bakerton. After enjoying a 14-game career as a minor league infielder in 1938, he served in the Army Air Forces' Eighth Air Force during World War II and spent 15 months as a German prisoner of war after flying 18 missions as a tailgunner on a B-17. Donatelli's plane was shot down during the first daylight raid on Berlin, and he suffered a broken ankle upon parachuting. He began umpiring softball games while a POW before being freed when Soviet troops overran the area. After the war, Donatelli opted for an umpiring career rather than a return to the coal mines near his hometown, and after graduating from Bill McGowan's school in 1946 worked in the Pioneer League in 1946, the South Atlantic League in 1947, and the International League in 1948–49.During his major league career, Donatelli umpired in the World Series in 1955 (outfield only), 1957, 1961, 1967 and 1973. He also officiated in the National League Championship Series in 1969 and 1972, serving as crew chief for the latter series, and in the three-game playoff series to determine the NL champion in both 1959 and 1962.

original_content: Flood Modeller is a computer program developed by Jacobs that assesses flood risk by simulating the flow of water through river channels, urban drainage networks and across floodplains using a range of one- and two-dimensional hydraulic solvers. The software incorporates a user interface for building, running and viewing the results of models, including a GIS map interface.The software has been independently benchmarked by the Environment Agency and is used extensively to undertake modelling of flood risk, develop flood risk management schemes and provide flood forecasting services.== Development History ==Initially developed by Halcrow Group and then CH2M Hill, Flood Modeller is now developed by Jacobs Solutions.  Flood Modeller was previously known as "ISIS" (after the local name for the Upper Thames).== Solvers ===== 1D solvers ===Flood Modeller includes steady-state and unsteady 1D river solvers for modelling open-channels.It also provides a 1D urban solver for modelling urban drainage systems.=== 2D solvers ===Flood Modeller includes three different 2D solvers:The ADI solver is based on the DIVAST numerical engine first developed in the 1980s, and is designed to simulate fluvial, overland, estuarine and coastal situations where flow does not rapidly change.The TVD solver is designed to represent rapid changes in the water surface profile, but results in longer run-times.The FAST solver uses simplified hydraulics to perform rapid assessments of flooding.

original_content: The Arroyo Penasco Group is a group of geological formations exposed in the Nacimiento, Jemez, Sandia, and Sangre de Cristo Mountains of northern New Mexico. It preserves fossils characteristic of the late Mississippian.== Description ==The Arroyo Penasco Group consists of marine sedimentary formations, primarily massive limestone but with some sandstone. It is divided into the lower Espiritu Santo Formation and the upper Tererro Formation.The lowermost part of the Espiritu Santo Formation is designated the Del Padre Member and is a transgressive siltstone, sandstone, and shale unit, which interfingers with the carbonate rocks of the upper Espiritu Santo Formation, recording the advance of the sea into the area. A similar sequence is seen in the Tererro Formation, whose base is a collapse breccia.The group rests everywhere on Precambrian basement that shows remarkably little relief, suggesting that the group was deposited on a peneplain. Its outcrops are spotty and its upper contact shows indications of well-developed karst topography, often filled in by the iron-rich sediments of the Log Springs Formation, indicating that it was heavily eroded before deposition of the Sandia Formation.The Espiritu Santo Formation has undergone dolomitization, dedolomitization, and calcitization of gypsum and the Macho Member (the lowest part of the Tererro Formation) has experienced dissolution and brecciation. Together with the presence of paleosilcretes in the Manuelitas Member, the middle part of the Tererro Formation, this suggests a history of at least four episodes of sea level fluctuation during the Mississippian in northern New Mexico.

content: קבוצת ארויו פנסקו היא קבוצה של תצורות גיאולוגיות החשופות בהרי נסימיינטו, ג'מז, סנדיה וסנגר דה קריסטו בצפון ניו מקסיקו. היא משמרת מאובנים המאפיינים את המיסיסיפי המאוחר.== תיאור ==קבוצת ארויו פנסקו מורכבת מתצורות משקע ימיות, בעיקר אבן גיר מאסיבית אך גם מעט אבן חול. היא מחולקת לתצורת אספיריטו סנטו התחתונה ולתצורת טררו העליונה.החלק התחתון ביותר של תצורת אספיריטו סנטו נקרא חבר דל פדרה והוא יחידת אבן בוץ, אבן חול ופצלים טרנסגרסיבית, המשתלבת בסלעי הקרבונט של תצורת אספיריטו סנטו העליונה, ומתעדת את התקדמות הים לאזור. רצף דומה נראה בתצורת טררו, שבסיסה הוא ברקציה קריסה.הקבוצה מונחת בכל מקום על מרתף פרה-קמבריוני שמראה מעט מאוד תבליט, מה שמרמז שהקבוצה הושקעה על פני פנפליין. המבנים שלה מפוזרים והמגע העליון שלה מראה סימנים של טופוגרפיית קרסט מפותחת היטב, המלאה לעתים קרובות במשקעים העשירים בברזל של תצורת לוג ספרינגס, מה שמצביע על כך שהיא נשחקה קשות לפני השקעת תצורת סנדיה.תצורת אספיריטו סנטו עברה דולומיטיזציה, דדולומיטיזציה וקליטיזציה של גבס וחבר מאצ'ו (החלק התחתון ביותר של תצורת טררו) חווה המסה וברקציה. יחד עם הימצאותם של פליאוסילרטים בחבר מנואליטס, החלק האמצעי של תצורת טררו, הדבר מצביע על היסטוריה של לפחות ארבע תקופות של תנודות מפלס הים במהלך המיסיסיפי בצפון ניו מקסיקו.

original_content: Ming Pao Daily News (Chinese: 明報; pinyin: Míng Bào), or Ming Pao for short, is a Chinese language newspaper in Canada owned by the Ming Pao Group of Hong Kong.Ming Pao in Canada has two editions. The Eastern edition (加東版; Jiā dōng bǎn) published in Toronto, Ontario was launched in May 1993 by then Chairman P.H. Yu, and competed in the local Chinese community with Sing Tao Daily and World Journal. The Toronto editorial offices are located in Agincourt. Shortly after in October 1993, the Western edition (加西版; Jiā xī bǎn) was launched in Vancouver, British Columbia.The paper is published 7 days a week in broadsheet format. News coverage include Canadian news (including national, provincial, city and community pages), international news, Hong Kong news, Mainland China and Taiwan news, plus lifestyle, entertainment, and sports sections.== Supplements (magazines) ==The Canada Eastern edition of Ming Pao publishes several weekly supplements (magazines). Unlike the situation in Hong Kong where the magazines are sold as separate publications, these are more properly called supplements that come free with the paper. The pages inside the magazines are also printed on newsprint instead of glossy paper.

original_content: The NIH MERIT award (Method To Extend Research in Time) Award (R37) was created by the National Institutes of Health in 1986. It is a prestigious award designed to provide stable, long-term funding support to outstanding, experienced investigators whose productivity is distinctly superior and who are deemed highly likely to continue to perform their research activities in an outstanding manner. The MERIT award provided funding for 5 years and could be renewed for up to 10 years. Unlike most NIH grant awards, the MERIT award can not be applied for by the investigator. Researchers submitting an R01 that receives a fundable score are considered for the award. In 2018, the NIH began awarding MERIT awards to "Early Stage Investigators", who are in the first 10 years of their career.

original_content: Vedder Crossing is adjacent to the junction of the Chilliwack and Vedder Rivers at its southern boundary, and Promontory Road to the north.== History ==The area was sparsely populated until about 1941 when CFB Chilliwack was established (then called Camp Chilliwack) between Watson Road and Keith Wilson.  The base became a major training facility for the Canadian Army until its closing in 1997.  Part of CFB Chilliwack became a residential subdivision known as Garrison Crossing, and its training facilities became the Canada Education Park, a local campus for the University of the Fraser Valley. The Chilcotin Training Area, better known as the OPSEE Area(Operator Special Engineering Equipment Training Area), is still operational and is part of Western Area Training Centre (WATC). The OPSEE Area is used by the Primary Reserves units of British Columbia for field training and for the use of its firing ranges. The ASU is also used by Cadets for field training. The ASU also houses supply depots for the Canadian Army units of 39 Canadian Brigade Group, and the cadet units of BC. The old quartermaster warehouse is now the Canadian Military Education Centre Museum.

original_content: The Fifth Labour Government of New Zealand was the government of New Zealand from 10 December 1999 to 19 November 2008. Labour Party leader Helen Clark negotiated a coalition with Jim Anderton, leader of the Alliance Party. While undertaking a number of substantial reforms, it was not particularly radical compared to previous Labour governments.== Overview ==The previous government, the fourth National government, had been in power since 1990. It was widely unpopular by 1999, with much of the public antagonised by a series of free-market economic reforms, and was bedevilled by weakness and instability. In the 1999 general election, the Helen Clark-led Labour Party defeated the National Party easily, becoming the largest single party in the House of Representatives. Labour formed a minority coalition government with the left-leaning Alliance party, supported by the Green Party.During its first term, the government pursued a number of reforms. The controversial Employment Contracts Act was repealed, replaced by an Employment Relations Act more friendly to unions and collective bargaining; a state-owned bank, Kiwibank, was created at the behest of the Alliance; a majority stake in the national airline, Air New Zealand, was purchased; and the public health sector was reorganised with the re-establishment of partly elected district health boards. == היסטוריה ==
בית הספר וייטהייבן נפתח בשנת 1984 וקלט תלמידים מבית הספר לדקדוק וייטהייבן שעבר לאתר אובראנד בשנת 1968, מבית הספר אובראנד עצמו שנפתח באתר זה בשנת 1960, ומבית הספר התיכון המודרני ברחוב ריצ'מונד שתפס את אתר בית הספר לדקדוק לשעבר בשנת 1969.

הוא עבר בדיקה מלאה בשנת 2004, שבה תואר כבית ספר משתפר גדול מהממוצע. צוין כי "הנסיבות הסוציו-אקונומיות של תלמידיו נמוכות בהרבה מהממוצע עם מספר גבוה מהממוצע שידוע כזכאי לארוחות חינם בבית הספר. הציונים בכניסה לבית הספר נמוכים מהממוצע; אלה של הבנים נמוכים בהרבה."

דו"ח מפברואר 2011 מהמשרד לסטנדרטים בחינוך, שירותי ילדים וכישורים (Ofsted) קבע שבית הספר וייטהייבן דאז עשה התקדמות בלתי מספקת בהשגת שיפורים והפגנת יכולת טובה יותר לשיפור מתמשך בשנתיים הקודמות, על פי דו"ח שפורסם בעקבות ביקור צוות Ofsted בינואר 2011. לינט נוריס, שמונתה למנהלת בשנת 2011, תוארה כמביאה "חזון ואנרגיה" לבית הספר מאז נכנסה לתפקידה.

original_content: The term bulk material analyzer is the generic noun for that device which fits around a conveyor belt and conducts real-time elemental analysis of the material on the belt.  Other names often found for such a device include belt analyzer, crossbelt analyzer and elemental analyzer. This product first found popularity in the cement industry during the 1990s, and today most new cement plants include at least one analyzer, if not two.== Cement industry ==A couple of applications predominate for the bulk material analyzer in cement production.=== Stockpile management ===One is known as "stockpile management," whereby an analyzer located upstream of the pile is able to track the cumulative chemistry of the pile.  This allows the operator to direct haul trucks to different sections of the quarry in a way that will result in the final elemental composition of the pile close to target.=== Raw mix proportioning ===A second application in cement for the bulk material analyzer is raw mix proportioning.  An analyzer placed just upstream of the raw mill can monitor the chemistry of the raw mix and automatically trigger an adjustment in the proportions of the reclaimed stockpile and the correctives.  By doing so, the plant is able to reduce the variability in the raw mix, and later on the kiln feed.  Consistent kiln feed chemistry in turn leads to lower fuel consumption per ton of clinker produced.
original_question: What was the specific purpose of a bulk material analyzer located just upstream of the raw mill in cement production?
original_answer: To monitor raw mix chemistry and adjust the proportions of materials used

original_content: The right of access, also referred to as right to access and (data) subject access, is one of the most fundamental rights in data protection laws around the world. The European Union states that: "The right of access occupies a central role in EU data protection law's arsenal of data subject empowerment measures." This right is often implemented as a Subject Access Request (SAR) or Data Subject Access Request (DSAR).== United Nations ==The aspirational Sustainable Development Goal 16, target 9, calls for the provision of legal identity for all human beings. "In the digital economy, this becomes the right to a digital identity." Such an identity could help in filing subject access requests.== Brazil ==Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD) is its first comprehensive data protection regulation. According to LGPD, subject access requests need to be fulfilled within 15 days.== European Union ==The right of access is enshrined as part of the fundamental right to data protection in the  Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union. It is in fact the only one of the practical rights relating to personal data that is listed there.In the GDPR, this right is defined in various sections of Article 15.

original_content: In South Africa, a tenderpreneur is a person in government or the private sector who obtains private or government tenders and contracts to facilitate outsourced services.  The word tenderpreneur is a portmanteau of "tendering" and "entrepreneur". Some commentators believe that this practice might give rise to a kleptocracy as a deviant mutation of a democracy if left unchecked. In this regard a kleptocracy is defined as the condition arising when a political elite manipulates the three arms of government (legislative, executive and judicial) with the intention of capturing resources that will enrich that elite, a general phenomenon known as elite capture.Tenderpreneurship is often accomplished by overpricing and/or shoddy workmanship and/or excessive 'under the table' advances termed "commissions".The Star, a South African newspaper, describes a tenderpreneur as "someone politically well-connected who has got rich through the government tendering system". In January 2010, South African Communist Party leader Blade Nzimande called for transparency in the awarding of tenders, saying "let's be bold, let's go and promote small entrepreneurs and defeat tenderpreneurs, those who steal." The case involving the Gupta family and their close ties to the administration of president Jacob Zuma can be classified as tenderpreneurism.

ארצ'ר קפיטל היא חברת השקעות פרטיות אוסטרלית שבסיסה בסידני. היא נוסדה בשם GS Private Equity בשנת 1996. ארצ'ר קפיטל מארחת קרנות השקעה מרובות המשקיעות בעסקים במגוון רחב של תעשיות וסקטורים, תוך התמקדות ספציפית ברכישות ממונפות בשוק הבינוני באוסטרליה ובניו זילנד. החברה מחזיקה כעת בבעלות משותפת או מלאה במספר חברות אוסטרליות וניו זילנדיות, כולל Allity ו-Craveable Brands. השקעות קודמות כוללות את Australian Geographic, Dome, John West Foods, MYOB, Rebel, Supercars Championship ו-Repco.

== השקעות בולטות ==
בשנת 1998, החברה יצרה שותפות עם ההנהלה דאז של Australian Geographic כדי לרכוש את העסק תמורת 50 מיליון דולר אוסטרלי. מאוחר יותר הוא נמכר לקונסורציום שכלל את משפחת Myer.

בשנת 2000, ארצ'ר קפיטל רכשה נתח של 50% בבתי הקפה Dome, ומכרה אותו בשנת 2003 תמורת 20 מיליון דולר אוסטרלי ל-Navis.

בשנת 2001, ארצ'ר הייתה חלק מקונסורציום (ששילם 30 מיליון דולר אוסטרלי) שרכש את Repco מ-Pacific Dunlop, והנפיק את החברה בבורסה האוסטרלית בשנת 2003.

ארצ'ר קפיטל הייתה מעורבת ברכישת John West Foods מיוניליוור בשנת 2003.
question: מה רכשה ארצ'ר קפיטל בשותפות עם הנהלת Australian Geographic ב-1998?
title: Archer Capital

original_content: Prizzi's Honor is a satirical crime novel by Richard Condon published in 1982.  It is the first of four novels featuring the Prizzis, a powerful family of Mafiosi in New York City. In all four novels the protagonist is a top member of the family named Charlie Partanna. It was adapted into a successful film of the same name. Prizzi's Honor was followed in 1986 by Prizzi's Family, which is a prequel story. Chronologically, the events in Prizzi's Honor are followed by the story of Prizzi's Money, which was the fourth and final Prizzi novel published, and also Condon's last work.== Plot summary ==The opening lines of the New York Times review summarize the complexities of the novel:CHARLEY PARTANNA, underboss of the Prizzi crime family, has a problem. He's just bumped off a traitor in Vegas who'd fleeced the organization to the tune of $720,000 - and now he's discovered that his new girlfriend, Irene, was the dead man's wife. As if that weren't enough of a headache, Charley's also learned that she's been augmenting her income as a tax consultant by working as a freelance hitter, and that she's now been offered a contract by a family rival to do the number on him. What a business for a woman!
